mapper.select: select r.id, r.user_id, r.sector_id, r.record_date, r.record_time, r.name, r.kcal, r.qty, r.created_at, s.name as sector_name, s.type as sector_type from t_record r left join t_sector s on r.sector_id = s.id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.record_date = #{date} order by r.record_time asc, r.id asc

select r.id, r.user_id, r.sector_id, r.record_date, r.record_time, r.name, r.kcal, r.qty, r.created_at, s.name as sector_name, s.type as sector_type from t_record r left join t_sector s on r.sector_id = s.id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.record_date between #{start} and #{end} order by r.record_date asc, r.record_time asc, r.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into t_record (user_id, sector_id, record_date, record_time, name, kcal, qty, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{sectorId}, #{recordDate}, #{recordTime}, #{name}, #{kcal}, #{qty}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from t_record where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
